rows.business_description:
The most revolutionary and transformational physical,mental, and emotional fitness program ever created. Built upon timeless principles that everything we do in life must be easy, correct, and enjoyable. G.I.F.T. Fitness's vision is to create the conditions and environments for all students to become the healthiest, happiest, and most confident supermodels and superleaders in the world. 
We want you to pause and think, what do we mean by creating the conditions? what do we mean by creating the environment? And why is this important? can we achieve levels of greatness without the right conditions? Can we manifest and create what we want without the right environment? 
In our fitness program, we make sure the right conditions are evident! The space, the equipment, and the resources that are needed for all students to win!
When we speak about conditions, specifically, we want to think about our beliefs, values, principles, the importance of what we say, our rituals and routines, and ultimately our habits!
But our vision doesn't  stop there. Our vision seeks for all its members to become. And to become what? the healthiest, the happiest, and most confident supermodels and superleaders in the world.
So why the healthiest? what can be more important than health? And if we are the best fitness program in the world, why not become the healthiest? Once we become the healthiest, what then? Shouldn't we seek to be the happiest? Our program understands that one we achieve greatness, all of it is not important unless we are happy!
Our mission is to train and to educate all of our students to develop into the healthiest, happiest, and most inspiring supermodels and superleaders in the our world.
Think about it, of all the fitness programs available in the world, none of them have been designed with a focus on intentionally creating an environment where all students clearly see and understand the direct impact of the power of our physical bodies and mental capacity while developing the social-emotional component within our students.
Gift fitness deliberately emphasizes the importance of education and the immediate application of what we learn to enhance the physical body,mind, and social-emotional practices.
We use the power of creating habits in all our fitness programs. We understand that motivation gets us started, but habits get us there. We know that habits are what we do unconsciously without giving them a second thought once established. "Lots of tiny improvements everyday is the secret to everlasting success." By James Clear from the atomic habit. We understand when we program and micro and macro habits leading to our goals, success in fitness and all areas of our lives are a sure thing. We accomplish this by equipping and ensuring that all our environments with the tools to meet the demands of all habits for physical, mental, emotional, and energetic fitness.
We use these habits to improve all levels of fitness. We have tight training systems and coaches to reinforce and develop all physical training progress and development that enhances strength, energy, and body composition.
We supply our kids with the proper foundation of mental fitness books that enhance concentration, thoughts, and awareness. 
The environment creates a culture of positive energy and actions, which enhances emotional fitness through the family and community in place. We use teaching tools and chants in the form of acronyms such as F.L.O.W., B.E.S.T. practices, G.R.I.T., and P.B.S.S. Designed to instill these words and what they stand for in our subconscious minds.
Lastly, we reinforce the timeless principle of giving to others through our actions and words. To promote school wellness and community growth.
The result students become and develop into the supermodels and superleaders of the world. Meaning they model and do the right thing all the time with courage and confidence. why supermodels? Why does modeling work? Kids don't do what you tell them, They do what you do. When you practice the correct values,principles,behaviors, then fuse that with the concept that as human beings, we are mimetic beings. We use the research from the book wanting by Luke Burgis and his mentor Rene Girard known as the father of mimetic analysis. Which states that human beings learn, follow, and imitate the people they surround themselves with. The outcome is that they understand, follow, and imitate the highest examples of human excellence in the world.
Why superleaders? Let's start with explaining what a leader is, someone who does the right thing at the right time at the right moment with courage. A superleader does the right thing all the time with courage and confidence. The correct action, speech, and intention all the time in everything they delegate or ask for. 
The outcome a better school system environment and the ultimate behaviors from our students not just in gyms and classrooms but more importantly in life. All leading to a better world.

Gomez Design Studio (GDS)  is a full-service design and fabrication studio specializing in custom furniture, architectural installations, and millwork for residential, commercial, and institutional spaces. With a strong commitment to sustainability, over 90% of our projects utilize salvaged and reclaimed construction waste, reducing environmental impact while delivering high-quality, durable, and design-forward solutions.

We partner with schools, colleges, and community organizations to design curricula that emphasize environmental responsibility, craftsmanship, and workforce development—equipping students, families, and educators with practical skills in woodworking, design, and material reuse.

As part of our broader mission, GDS also acts as a connector within the local ecosystem, fostering partnerships with artisans, makers, and small businesses to support community-driven projects. Whether sourcing specialized fabrication, sharing resources, or matching clients with the right creative collaborators, we help bring ideas to life through intentional partnerships that support the local economy.

Our circular economy model links sustainable production with education and community collaboration—turning waste into opportunity and fostering the next generation of makers, designers, and problem-solvers who will carry forward the values of sustainability, creativity, and economic empowerment.

Our curriculum is paired with live workshops to further guide participants to apply essential soft skills to their personal and professional lives. In educational and developmental environments, Blooming With Intention provides social emotional learning (SEL) programs designed to achieve whole community well-being by expanding a school’s focus and enrichment from IQ to EQ for students, staff, parents, and caretakers. 
  -Consulting, Coaching, Training & Mentorship offerings that equip organizations to enhance employee well-being programs.  We provide turnkey mentorship and sponsorship programs, coaching, and training services that extend beyond the C-suite to the greater community, in an effort to foster equity, advancement, and true commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.

Each month, we offer two free virtual events to the public, as well a selection of private workshops, mastermind and support groups offered virtually through The Well Zone, and through in-person events and retreats.

We serve clients throughout Westchester, New York City, and the surrounding tri-state area, with a focus on delivering well-coordinated, detail-oriented construction services for public, commercial, institutional, and private-sector projects. 

Our company combines hands-on construction experience with in-house millwork capabilities, allowing us to manage projects from planning and coordination through fabrication, installation, and final completion. Our services include interior renovations, office and facility upgrades, custom cabinetry, reception desks, built-ins, wall panels, casework, doors, trim, finish carpentry, painting, flooring coordination, and related interior improvement work. 

Westchester Luxury Interiors is committed to professionalism, reliability, quality craftsmanship, and clear communication. We understand the importance of working safely, meeting project schedules, coordinating with owners and other trades, and maintaining clean, organized job sites, especially in occupied buildings, schools, offices, and active commercial environments. 

As a certified MBE/DBE business, we are proud to bring both technical capability and diverse business participation to public and private projects. We are experienced in working with general contractors, agencies, property owners, designers, architects, and facility managers, and we are well-positioned to support projects requiring skilled interior construction, custom millwork, and dependable project execution. 

Our goal is to provide clients with a reliable partner who can deliver high-quality work, practical solutions, and a finished product that reflects care, craftsmanship, and attention to detail. Whether working as a prime contractor, subcontractor, or specialty millwork provider, Westchester Luxury Interiors brings a professional, client-focused approach to every project.

Our expertise in event management covers a wide array of services tailored for schools. Further enhancing our marketing repertoire, we produce documentary-style cinema videos. By visiting schools and immersing ourselves in their environment, we craft authentic and compelling video narratives. These aren't just visual tours of the facilities; they are deep dives into the essence and ethos of the schools, beautifully capturing their unique atmosphere and spirit.

DLE Event Group's fusion of event management expertise and innovative marketing strategies positions us as a leading partner for schools in New York City. We don't just organize events and create content; we celebrate and amplify the unique stories of educational communities, leaving an indelible mark on all who engage with them.

rows.business_description:
FortyLove is a leading photo and video production company, proudly certified as a Minority and Women-Owned Business Enterprise (MWBE) by both New York State and New York City. Based in NYC, we specialize in producing high-quality visual content for both commercial brands and government clients. With a team of experienced professionals, we deliver exceptional work across various industries including fashion, lifestyle, real estate, healthcare, technology, and public sector projects.

At FortyLove, we’re storytellers at heart, bringing creativity, technical skill, and innovation to every project we undertake. Our services span from concept development through post-production, ensuring that we provide an end-to-end solution for all visual production needs. We have earned the trust of globally recognized brands and government agencies by consistently delivering compelling content with a commitment to quality, professionalism, and inclusivity.

MWBE Certification

As an MWBE-certified company, FortyLove is committed to supporting diversity and inclusion in the workforce. This certification allows us to participate in government contracting opportunities, where MWBE engagement is prioritized, and enables clients to meet their diversity goals. We ensure that every project not only reflects high standards of craftsmanship but also promotes equitable representation, both in front of and behind the camera.

Our Services

FortyLove offers a wide range of photo and video production services, catering to the unique needs of commercial and government clients. Our expertise extends to various types of projects, including branding campaigns, public service announcements, product shoots, corporate events, and more. Below are our primary service offerings:

1. Commercial Photo and Video Production
We work with brands across industries to create visually stunning content that enhances their message and engages their target audience. Our commercial services include:

Advertising Campaigns: Creating eye-catching visuals that build brand awareness.
Product Photography & Videography: Highlighting product features and quality for marketing purposes.
Corporate Videos: Producing company profiles, testimonials, and internal communication content.
Event Coverage: Documenting key moments at corporate events, launches, and trade shows.
Social Media Content: Generating dynamic visuals optimized for social platforms.
Fashion & E-commerce Photography: Crafting professional lookbooks and product images that drive sales.
2. Government Photo and Video Production
FortyLove is experienced in working with government agencies to produce content that meets strict compliance and quality standards. Our government services include:

Public Service Announcements (PSAs): Communicating important messages to the public.
Training Videos: Creating instructional content for employees and the public.
Documentary Production: Capturing critical social, political, and environmental issues.
Infrastructure Documentation: Recording the progress of public works and infrastructure projects.
Event Documentation: Providing professional coverage of government events and initiatives.
Emergency Response & Preparedness Videos: Helping public safety departments communicate important guidelines.
As a certified MWBE, we ensure all diversity and inclusion goals are met in compliance with state and federal regulations, making us an ideal partner for government contracting.

3. End-to-End Production Services
We offer comprehensive production services that cover every aspect of a project, from pre-production planning to final delivery. Our full-service capabilities include:

Pre-Production: Creative development, budgeting, casting, location scouting, and permitting.
Production: On-set photography and videography, drone filming, and live-streaming.
Post-Production: Professional editing, sound design, color grading, motion graphics, and VFX.
We also handle all necessary compliance, ensuring that each project meets regulatory standards, particularly in the case of government contracts or productions involving minors.

4. Specialized Services
Multilingual Content: We produce content in various languages, ensuring it resonates with diverse audiences.
Green Production: Offering eco-friendly production practices for clients focused on sustainability.
Government Contracting: Our expertise in public sector work and MWBE certification makes us a trusted partner for government agencies.

We are the hub where cannabis meets community, innovation, and equity.

rows.business_description:
S & S Health and Wellness is a mobile, community-centered wellness company dedicated to fostering holistic health and empowerment across New York City and surrounding areas. As a Black-owned, family-operated business based in the Bronx, we are proud to serve diverse communities through accessible wellness programs, trauma informed services, and natural self-care products. Our mission is to bridge the wellness gap by offering culturally relevant practices that support the whole person—mind, body, and spirit.

We specialize in providing customized, scalable wellness programming to schools, early childhood centers, public agencies, afterschool programs, housing developments, senior centers, and community-based organizations. With a unique blend of yoga, mindfulness, music and movement (such as Zumbini®), holistic education, and natural wellness products, like smoothies and wellness drinks, our work supports social-emotional learning (SEL), mental health, emotional regulation, and community well-being.

Our offerings include:
 • Children’s Yoga & Mindfulness: Evidence-based, age-appropriate classes for preschoolers, school-age children, 
teens and college students that promote focus, self-regulation, movement, and calm.
 • Family and Community Wellness Events: Interactive wellness workshops, movement circles, sound baths, and outdoor yoga sessions for families and caregivers.
 • Staff Wellness for Schools & Agencies: Self-care sessions, restorative yoga, and mindfulness trainings for educators, social workers, and staff to reduce burnout and increase resilience.
 • Holistic Products: Our signature line of handmade, small-batch products—including magnesium sprays, essential oil inhalers, and soothing balms—support physical and emotional wellness and are often incorporated into our workshops and offerings.
 • Music & Movement for Early Childhood: Zumbini® for Schools and community programs, where we combine music, dance, and play to support early learning and bonding in a joyful, high-energy format.
 • Seasonal and Culturally Relevant Events: We also organize and lead events like community healing circles, yoga in the park, and holistic pop-ups that reflect the needs and values of the communities we serve.

Why Partner With Us
We are passionate about meeting people where they are—physically, emotionally, and culturally. Our programs are adaptable, trauma-informed, and inclusive of all bodies, abilities, and backgrounds. As a mobile business, we bring services directly to your location—whether it’s a school gym, park, shelter, library, or community center.

We are currently collaborating with local schools, early childhood programs, community organizations, and city agencies to offer services that uplift, educate, and nurture. Our work directly supports public health goals around:
 • Stress and trauma reduction
 • Mental health awareness
 • Youth empowerment and resilience
 • Family engagement
 • Community building through arts and wellness

S & S Health and Wellness is fully insured, has passed background checks for working with children and families,DOE  and is MWBE certified to expand our contracting opportunities. We are open to short-term projects, recurring contracts, and one-time events depending on your agency’s needs.

rows.business_description: Ideal Apparel of NYC specialize in providing high-quality, fully customized clothing and gear for schools, businesses, and organizations across the city. From uniforms to spirit wear, our mission is to deliver style, comfort and quality.We are committed to delivering exceptional value, fast turnaround, and personalized service for both educational institutions and public service departments.

Power Up Ed LLC aims to expand the leadership capacity of principals and the teaching capacity of educators through job-embedded collaborative coaching that is personalized to meet the schools’ needs.

1) Personalized Support: Our process begins by understanding the school-wide improvement goals and helping the principals identify both an instructional goal and a system that will support meaningful change. We then work with the leadership team to create a personalized, site-based work plan that is rooted in the school's goals and aspirations. The work plan serves as a roadmap for the year, clearly articulating: the expected outcomes of the coaching, the supports required to ensure effective implementation, and a breakdown of activities and deliverables by semester.

2) Collaborative Coaching: Our collaborative coaching style emphasizes the co-creation of meaning, solutions, and actions between me and those I coach. Our success relies not only on our critical reflection and pedagogical knowledge, but also on the content and contextual expertise of the educators. We believe the educators we coach are the best source of information, insight, and learning for the challenges they face. It is therefore our role as their coach to support and partner with them to explore, understand, and influence their situations.

3) Job-Embedded Development: School improvement research shows that significant shifts in teaching and learning require broad systemic shifts that support instructional change. Each school we work with receives coaching in not only instruction, but also the design of school-wide systems and structures necessary to support the instructional goals. We work with teachers one-on-one and in teams to adopt high-impact pedagogical practices. We work with the leadership team to research and rethink how teachers empower students to achieve high academic expectations. We provide ongoing technical assistance to schools by analyzing existing systems and structures and assessing where new systems need to be built.  Throughout our work together, we support the team in the constant collection and analysis of student data, an iterative revision of teaching tools and practices, and the continuous examination of evidence of instructional shifts.

Our founder, Rasheeda Frazier, started Empowering Greatness Inc. in 2012 as an effort to assist minority high school students and young adults with preparatory instruction for the higher education application process and introduction to the world of business and entrepreneurship. She wanted to give her mentees an alternative to the traditional push to collegiate studies after high school. Her passion was fueled by the lack of knowledge around options and resources within her community.

Today, Empowering Greatness Inc. has expanded its reach to budding entrepreneurs and existing businesses within their local communities and on a global scale. Our approach is to help jumpstart their business with the development of a sound blueprint, ensuring that they are organized correctly for their industry to support future growth. We are the missing link that most entrepreneurs need to bridge the gap between their ideas and their successes.

rows.business_description:
VNB Business Brokers is a business brokerage, business consulting, exit planning and value growth advisory firm that offers a comprehensive range of services to small and medium-sized businesses. Our goal is to help business owners achieve their objectives by providing them with the tools and expertise they need to understand the value of their business, find ways to improve value and ultimately be better prepared for a sale, now or in the future.

Credentialed as a Certified Business Intermediary, Certified Mergers & Acquisition Professional, Certified Exit Planning Advisor and as members of leading industry associations, such as the International Business Brokers Association, M&A Source, and Exit Planning Institute, we are qualified to work with businesses across a wide range of industries to help them improve their operations, grow their revenue, and increase profitability. Whether you are looking to develop a new business strategy, optimize your existing operations, or sell your business, we are here to help.

We understand the challenges facing small and medium-sized businesses and know that running a successful business takes more than just hard work and determination. It also requires a strategic approach to business planning, marketing, sales, operations, and finance. That's why we offer a full suite of business consulting services designed to help business owners navigate these challenges and achieve their goals.

Our business coaching services are designed to help business owners identify their strengths and weaknesses, and develop a strategic plan for growth. We work closely with our clients to develop customized solutions that are tailored to their specific needs, and we provide ongoing support and guidance to ensure they stay on track.

Our business improvement services are focused on helping businesses optimize their operations, increase efficiency, and reduce costs. We use a data-driven approach to identify areas for improvement, and we work with our clients to implement changes that will drive results.

Our value growth services are designed to help businesses increase their overall value and prepare for a successful sale. We help business owners identify and address potential issues that could impact their sale price, and we work with them to develop a comprehensive strategy for maximizing their business's value.

In addition to our consulting services, we also provide advisory services to small and medium-sized business owners who are looking to sell their business. We have a proven track record of success in helping business owners sell their businesses for maximum value, and we use our expertise and experience to guide our clients through the entire process.

At VNB Business Brokers, we are committed to providing our clients with the highest level of service and support. We pride ourselves on our professionalism, integrity, and commitment to our clients' success. Whether you are looking to grow your business, optimize your operations, or sell your business, we are here to help. Contact us today to learn more about our services and how we can help your business succeed.

rows.business_description:
High Maintenance NY, Inc. is owned and operated by Vanessa Despot Rippere and is a Leed certified, QEWI, QPSI, QRWI firm. As a NYS Registered Architect and QEWI, Ms. Rippere leads the NYC FISP Team and Parking Structures Team, Professional Engineer included, to help Owners and Property Managers stay in compliance with New York City’s Local Laws.

We are your EXPERTS in:
• NYC FISP (formerly known as Local Law 11 (LL11/98)
The Facade Inspection & Safety Program (FISP), formerly known as LL11, requires periodic assessment of all buildings higher than 6 stories. All exterior walls and appurtenances must be  inspected every five years as per NYC's building code and new façade rules in effect. A QEWI is either a Registered Architect or Professional Engineer who has been interviewed and approved by the Department of Buildings (DOB). As a QEWI, we provide all related FISP services and prepare the required Technical Report (TR6). In addition, physical close-up inspections must be performed no more than 60’ apart at facades fronting the public right of way. If the building has a cavity wall, at least 1 probe must be done at each drop (inspection done from the ground to the top of the exterior wall) to inspect the presence and condition of the wall ties. The remaining facades must also be inspected, but does not require this physical close-up inspection. At High Maintenance NY, we can perform an entire façade inspection in just one day via IRA (industrial rope access) because it’s faster to mobilize/demobilize and relocate drops throughout the façade. It also helps that our FISP team has the experience and dedication to get the job done!

• PARKING STRUCTURES - Local Law 126 (LL126/21)
LL126 requires periodic assessment of all parking structures within the five boroughs of New York City every six years to ensure that they’re maintained in a safe condition. Owners are responsible for the proper inspection, repair, and maintenance of their parking structures, which must be examined by a Qualified Parking Structure Inspector (QPSI), and a report filed with the DOB. As a QPSI, we inspect these parking structures with a very thoughtful approach. It can be a small garage or a very large, multilevel garage that requires a thorough and efficient inspection approach. We then take all this visual data and transfer it into an easy to read report that is convenient to our Clients.  

• RETAINING WALLS - Local Law 37/08 (LL37/08)
LL37/08 requires owners of properties with a retaining wall or part of a retaining wall, which is at least ten feet high and faces a public right of way (including sidewalks or entrances), to have a condition assessment completed every five years. They must also file an assessment report (TR16) submitted to the Department of Buildings by a Professional Engineer (PE), who has a minimum of three years of relevant experience and is also an approved Qualified Retaining Wall Inspectors (QRWI). We have noticed that these retaining walls have fallen into disrepair due to the lack of maintenance. We advise our Clients how to repair them in a cost effective and minimally invasive manner.
 
High Maintenance NY Services:
We work with Clients both in the private and public sector, from a small building to a large development. We value our conversations with the Client and try to understand what their needs are so we can provide solutions. We offer architectural and engineering services for all phases of a project. This includes design, construction administration (includes bidding and negotiation), expediting (for NYC DOB job filings), and project close-out. We prepare the necessary reports, repair drawings, specifications, and forms for the Client and DOB. Upon getting the DOB’s approved plans, the Contractor can pull permits to do the repair work. During the construction phase, we can be on-site and mark out the initial work on the building, inspect the progress work, and inspect the final work to ensure that work is being done as per the approved DOB plans. Upon the completion of the construction phase, we can also provide the necessary reports to file with DOB, so your building complies with the law. 

What makes High Maintenance NY different?
We are driven by a moral commitment to be methodical and transparent in our assessments. We help clients achieve their safety goals via expert and insightful identification, quantification and mitigation of the risks that could negatively impact their property. 
We love what we do and believe in keeping NYC safe.  Rest assured that our clients can be confident that we are thinking about what repairs must be made now to satisfy the law while also providing a reasonable repair solution that benefits the client. We will never declare a building unsafe to provide an extensive, unnecessary, unreasonable repair program. We value the safety of OUR CITY and that drives us to provide great service in OUR WORK!

Katiuscia Gray was raised in Hollis Queens New York. Raised in a Haitian household by her grandparents and aunts and cousins. Chaos and trauma were a bit part of her life. Childhood sexual abuse, domestic violence and abandonment was a tremendous part of her earlier years. That trauma was stored not just in her mind but in her body also, which made her anxious, angry, hypervigilant always ked up and on edge.

All of this hurt and pain sent her on a journey to try to heal herself and her community since so many people where just like her. She got a degree in Social work and then became a licensed clinical social worker, LCSW-R. During this time, she got married and had children. The stress of working and being married and having young children and never really fully healing from all of her traumas transitioned into headaches and gut issues. After ruling out medical issues, at the recommendation of her doctor she took her first yoga class and loved it. She loved it so much that she went for a yoga teacher certification in 2018. It was then that Mind Meets Movement counseling services, PLLC was developed. A Holistic mental health practice that incorporates a number of healing modalities including breath work, mindfulness, cognitive behavior therapy, play therapy, trauma therapy and light yoga moves, so patients can get the most out of their therapy sessions. Mind Meets Movement Counseling Services mission and passion is there is more than one way to heal. And we cannot heal the mind without incorporating the body. Proudly the private practice services children, adolescents, young adults and adults.

Our minority-owned firm strives to foster equitable departmental cultures by investing in the personal and professional growth of employees.
Our Founder & Managing Principal, David DeVaughn, is an International Coaching Federation (ICF) Professional Certified Coach (PCC) with over 15 years of experience. His expertise spans coaching and leadership development; diversity, equity, inclusion, belonging, and justice; interactive workshops, training, and curriculum development; non-profit management, institutional consulting, and equity-centered strategic advisory services, all tailored to meet the complex needs of our clients, including those in regulated government environments.
We specialize in delivering our services through a blend of interactive workshops, practical exercises, and virtual training classes, designed to enhance leadership capabilities within the specific context of government agencies. Our training programs emphasize ethical leadership, promoting a culture of integrity and accountability, and are adept at navigating the unique challenges of public sector administration.
Key topics we cover include, but are not limited to: Diverse Multigenerational Talent Management and Supervision; Personal Development; Change Management and Company Culture; Strategic Thinking; Decision-Making and Problem Solving; Communication and Influence; Team Building and Collaboration; Managing Resistance; Adaptive Leadership; and Equity-Responsive Leadership. Additionally, we specialize in Leveraging Your Executive Presence to Maximize Impact, Leveraging Your Executive Presence to Lead, and providing tailored programs such as Executive Presence for Across Gender. Our curriculum also emphasizes mastering effective communication through workshops like Communicating with Confidence, Clarity, and Credibility and navigating the complexities of digital dialogues in Virtual Communication – Dos and Taboos. Further, we equip leaders with skills in Presentation Strategies and Executive Presentation Strategies, enabling them to deliver compelling and persuasive presentations. Moreover, our training includes guidance on Navigating Tough Conversations and Feedback, ensuring leaders are well-prepared to handle difficult interactions with balanced confidence.
By integrating self-awareness and emotional intelligence into our leadership training, we prepare leaders to manage complex scenarios and foster a collaborative, inclusive work environment. This comprehensive training empowers leaders at all levels to effectively address challenges, seize opportunities, and achieve sustainable results.

2Hands2Help Inc is a boutique group therapy practice. Our practice is comprised of licensed therapists from diverse walks of life with one common thread; We are women of color who prioritize working with people of color from all walks of life-across age, groups, and genders. We work together to hold culturally sensitive, safe and LGBTQIA+ affirming spaces for our clients. Our goal as a practice is to support individuals and families by addressing their concerns, celebrating accomplishments as people and encouraging them to reach their highest mental and emotional self.  Our goal is to support individuals in reaching their desired mindset or lifestyle.
Our group has over 20 years of experience as clinicians. We integrate psychotherapy with a holistic approach, respecting a person's individual lived experience and viewing them as a whole person. We prioritize culturally competent, gender and sexuality affirming, trauma informed care.  Our approach is based on evidence based practices, coupled with real world experience and clinical expertise areas. As a business we have incorporated opportunities that align with our individual strengths, our professional skill set and our mission to deliver healing throughout diasporic communities.

As a result, an afterschool curriculum was curated to provide the social and emotional learning for children and their families post pandemic. Our program seeks to disrupt and provide tools for children and their primary caregivers who have been negatively impacted by the events of the pandemic and reside in communicates that often expose them to single or multiple instances of trauma. The Adverse Childhood Experiences (ACEs) Study, provides data correlation between 10 key major risk factors for children and their families contributing to the worst health and social problems in the United States currently. The program seeks to address the needs of the children while educating and supporting their families as well.

rows.business_description:
GoodWerk Mental Health Counseling is deeply committed to offering a robust suite of services tailored to the diverse needs of our clients. At the heart of our operations is a culturally responsive approach designed to support, uplift, and empower marginalized and underserved communities. Our commitment lies in affirming individuals and communities to own their power, confidence, and voices through our diverse services ranging from mental health therapy and life coaching to professional training and counseling supervision. In creating a safe space for healing and self-expression, we specialize in providing culturally responsive care to BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ communities. 

Our services include:
? Biopsychosocial Evaluation: An essential first step for all clients, this comprehensive assessment gives us a nuanced understanding of the client's lived experiences and their relation to psychosocial stressors and challenges.
? Individual Therapy: These one-on-one sessions with a mental health professional provide a platform to explore unique challenges, identify self-determined goals, and build adaptive coping mechanisms.
? Couples Therapy: Our couples therapy provides a safe space for couples to work through relationship challenges, commitment resistance, and marriage readiness, building towards mutually agreed-upon goals.
? Family Therapy: In these sessions, families meet with a mental health professional to examine family dynamics, understand challenges in familial practices, and work towards collective goals.
? Individual or Group Supervision: Supervisees are guided towards becoming well-rounded, culturally responsive counselors in our supervision services, which are rooted in the discrimination supervision model.
? Consultation & Training: Our comprehensive consulting and training programs focus on diversity, equity, inclusion, and justice work, offering crucial support to organizations committed to supporting BIPOC and LGBTQ+ communities.
? Individual Coaching: Designed to foster self-awareness, clarity, and confidence, our one-on-one coaching sessions support clients as they navigate challenges and work towards their goals. Our coaches hold globally recognized credentials from the International Coaching Federation (ICF).

At GoodWerk, we take pride in the transformative effect of our services, which are built to make a positive difference in the lives of our clients. For further information, please visit our website at www.thisisgoodwerk.com.

FCI – The Language Experts is well-equipped to provide valuable language services to the vibrant and diverse city of New York. With our extensive experience serving commercial, governmental, and individual clients worldwide, we can address the linguistic needs of various industries and communities within the city.

Translation and Localization:
As a melting pot of cultures and languages, New York City thrives on effective communication across diverse communities. FCI offers comprehensive translation and localization services, enabling businesses, organizations, and government agencies to reach and engage their target audiences effectively. Whether it's translating marketing materials, legal documents, educational resources, or any other type of content, our expert linguists ensure accurate and culturally sensitive communication.

Multilingual Customer Support:
New York City attracts people worldwide, creating a diverse customer base for businesses and service providers. FCI can assist in establishing multilingual customer support services, allowing companies to provide exceptional service to customers in their preferred languages. We enhance customer satisfaction and foster positive brand experiences by bridging language barriers.

Interpretation Services:
In a city as dynamic as New York, real-time interpretation is vital for effective communication in various scenarios. FCI offers professional interpretation services, including simultaneous, consecutive, and remote interpretation, to facilitate seamless communication in business meetings, conferences, legal proceedings, healthcare settings, and more. Our qualified interpreters ensure accurate and confidential communication between individuals who speak different languages.

Government and Public Sector Support:
As a certified women-owned small business, FCI can provide language services to support New York City government initiatives and public sector projects. Our experienced linguists are well-versed in working with government agencies, ensuring compliance with regulations, and delivering high-quality translations of legal documents, public notices, community outreach materials, and more.

Educational Support:
New York City's educational landscape is enriched by its diverse student population. FCI can contribute to inclusive learning environments by providing translation and interpretation services for schools, colleges, and educational institutions. We assist in translating educational materials, supporting parent-teacher conferences, facilitating communication with non-English-speaking students and their families, and more.

With our commitment to ISO 9001 compliance, stringent quality control processes, and a vast network of qualified language professionals, FCI is well-positioned to serve the language needs of New York City. Our mission is to bridge the communication gaps and promote inclusivity across diverse communities, enabling businesses, organizations, and individuals to thrive in this vibrant city.

For more information on how FCI – The Language Experts can support language services in New York City, please visit our website at [www.fcitle.com]. We would be delighted to discuss your specific requirements and provide tailored solutions for your linguistic needs.

Together, let's empower effective communication and foster greater understanding in the diverse and dynamic city of New York.
